original.title: Funds of knowledge for teaching: Using a qualitative approach to connect homes and classrooms

core_idea: Households, including working-class and migrant ones, hold bodies of knowledge and skills built through work and daily life. Teachers who visit and learn from families can build teaching on this knowledge.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How can teachers use students' home knowledge in the classroom?
How do migrant or rural families support learning?
Typical data: ethnographic home visits, interviews, classroom case studies.
common_mistakes: Reducing funds of knowledge to students' hobbies or cultural food.
Skipping the ethnographic stance of teachers as learners.
Assuming all household knowledge is positive and easy to bring into school.
